title: Patch: the patch notes' card diff covers every catalog field, so a new field fails typecheck and not a release
thread:
**Issue #2607 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #2607: Patch: the patch notes' card diff covers every catalog field, so a new field fails typecheck and not a release
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
When a card change ships, the patch-notes page compares each card before and after and lists what changed. That comparison keeps its own hand-written list of the fields a card has. When the catalog gains a field the list doesn't know, the release step that ships the patch gets stuck, as it did last week until one field was added by hand. One field, the prices on the six Stinkyscape Resource tokens, is still missing, so the first change to those prices will stick the next release in the same way. Once this is built, the list is checked against the card's type, so adding a field to cards fails the web's typecheck in the pull request that adds it.

## Why
- `apps/web/src/patches/diff.ts` keeps `FIELD_LABEL` (`:46`), `DATA_ONLY_FIELDS` (`:78`) and `KNOWN_KEYS` (`:80`) by hand, apart from the generated `CardDef`.
- #2585 (7836f89a8, "a patches promotion or log is stuck") added `snapshotOf` to these tables after `patches ship` stuck.
- `diff.test.ts:256` ("R388 every card every patch records diffs to what the record says: its kind and exactly its fields") fails as soon as the diff names a field the record does not.
- `resource` is a `CardDef` key (`wire/generated/CardDef.ts:64`) carried by stinkyscape-t-reknite, -t-korrelite, -t-gellium, -t-axnit, -t-narcor and -t-red-narcor. It is not in `KNOWN_KEYS`. So the diff names a change to it `data:resource` (`diff.ts:234-240`), while `changed_fields` (`crates/tools/src/patches.rs:1039`) records it as `resource`.

## Proposal
- Type the tables over `keyof CardDef`, for example with a `satisfies Record<keyof CardDef, …>` that marks each key as labeled, data-only or ignored, so a key the tables lack is a type error.
- Add `resource`, with a label.
- Add a `diff.test.ts` case with a planted `resource` change that names the field as `changed_fields` does.

## Where it lands
`apps/web/src/patches/diff.ts`, `apps/web/src/patches/diff.test.ts`, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`. R388, R507.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Adding a field to `CardDef` without an entry, or removing an entry, fails `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`.
- [ ] A planted change to a Resource token's `resource` diffs under the field `resource`, and a record naming `resource` passes the R388 test.
- [ ] Every existing patch note renders as before (`diff.test.ts` and `PatchNotes.test.tsx` pass).

## Size and risks
Small, 2 to 3 files. It does not touch play. The only open choice is whether a Resource's prices print on its face or are data only, and the builder should follow what the Marketplace shows.

## Goal

The patch-notes card diff in `apps/web/src/patches/diff.ts` builds its known keys and its data-only fields from one table typed over `keyof CardDef`. `FIELD_LABEL` is typed over that table too. So a `CardDef` field with no entry, or an entry with no `CardDef` field, fails `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`. `resource` (the prices on the six Stinkyscape Resource tokens) gets a label and is diffed under the field name `resource`, which is the name `changed_fields` (`crates/tools/src/patches.rs:1039`) records. It prints on the card's face. Every existing patch note diffs as before.

## Files to touch

| Path | new/change | What |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/patches/diff.ts` | change | new `KeyRole`, `CARD_KEYS`, `CardKey`, `LabeledKey`, `FaceField`; `FIELD_LABEL` gains `resource`, `ingredients`, `craft` and a `satisfies`; `DATA_ONLY_FIELDS` and `KNOWN_KEYS` derived from `CARD_KEYS`; new `resourceText`; three `value(...)` lines in `fieldChanges` |
| `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | three label entries after `"Copy of"` |
| `apps/web/src/patches/diff.test.ts` | change | `asDiffField` and `expectRecorded` move to module level; the real-history R388 test uses them; two new tests |

Do not touch anything else:
- no file in `crates/` (`changed_fields` already records `resource` by name)
- no file in `spec/` (no new ruling)
- nothing generated under `apps/web/src/wire/`
- not `ChangeList.tsx`, `PatchNotes.tsx` or `fixtures.ts`

The rulings that govern this:
- R388: patch history
- R507: printed changes versus data-only ones
- R2521009: a Resource's face prints its Credits
- R1840000 and R1840001: what `resource` holds
- R1437000: `flavor` is ignored

## Steps

1. **`apps/web/src/patches/diff.ts`: insert the role table.** Put it after `export const NOT_RECORDED = "not recorded";` (line 44) and before `export const FIELD_LABEL`, exactly:

```ts
/** How the diff reads one `CardDef` key (#2607). A `printed` key and a `data` one (R507: no face prints
 * it) each have a `FIELD_LABEL` entry and a line of their own in `fieldChanges`, under the key's own
 * name, the name `patches ship` records (`changed_fields`, R388); a `face` is diffed field by field
 * (`base.text`, `radiant.stats`); an `ignored` key is never a change. */
type KeyRole = "printed" | "data" | "face" | "ignored";

/** Every `CardDef` key and its role, so a key `CardDef` gains with no entry here, or an entry for a key
 * it lost, fails the web's typecheck (#2607), as a printed or data key with no `FIELD_LABEL` does. R507:
 * fields without printed faces are listed by name. R1748001 and R1748002's flags are the Buff's data,
 * and so is the Core card a Training Grounds copy named (`snapshotOf`, in the catalogs shipped from
 * v0.5.5 to v0.5.7; R2511001). A Resource's prices print: its face prints its Credits (R2521009). */
const CARD_KEYS = {
  // The card itself: a delta's `id`, never one of its changes.
  id: "ignored",
  index: "printed",
  name: "printed",
  set: "printed",
  type: "printed",
  tags: "printed",
  rarity: "printed",
  printedRarity: "printed",
  // R1437000: display only and in no snapshot, so a change to it alone is no card change.
  flavor: "ignored",
  token: "printed",
  cost: "printed",
  refs: "data",
  params: "data",
  dealsDamage: "data",
  usesPlague: "data",
  resource: "printed",
  loc: "data",
  radiantFallback: "printed",
  // A Fuse's and a crafter's own (R179, R882), on a transient definition no snapshot holds.
  ingredients: "data",
  craft: "data",
  snapshotOf: "data",
  base: "face",
  radiant: "face",
} as const satisfies Record<keyof CardDef, KeyRole>;

type CardKey = keyof typeof CARD_KEYS;
/** The keys with a line of their own: every printed and data one. */
type LabeledKey = { [K in CardKey]: (typeof CARD_KEYS)[K] extends "printed" | "data" ? K : never }[CardKey];
/** What `fieldChanges` diffs on each face, under `<face>.<field>`. */
type FaceField = `${FaceKey}.${"type" | "stats" | "keywords" | "text" | "grants"}`;
```

2. **Same file: extend `FIELD_LABEL`.**
   - After its last entry, `snapshotOf: "Copy of",`, add these three in this order: `resource: "Resource prices",`, `ingredients: "Ingredients",`, `craft: "Recipe",`.
   - Change its closing `} as const;` to `} as const satisfies Record<LabeledKey | FaceField, string>;`.
   - Leave every existing entry as it is.

3. **Same file: replace `DATA_ONLY_FIELDS` and `KNOWN_KEYS`.**
   - Delete the doc comment `/** R507: fields without printed faces … R2511001). */` (lines 75–77). Its words now sit on `CARD_KEYS`.
   - Delete the `DATA_ONLY_FIELDS` line (78).
   - Delete the whole `KNOWN_KEYS` set (lines 80–102), including its `flavor` comment.
   - Put this in their place:

```ts
const DATA_ONLY_FIELDS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(Object.entries(CARD_KEYS).flatMap(([key, role]) => (role === "data" ? [key] : [])));

const KNOWN_KEYS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(Object.keys(CARD_KEYS));
```

   Do not change `printsOnFace`, `dataOnly`, `faceShown` or the loose `data:<key>` fallback (the "Anything else the catalog grows" block in `fieldChanges`). A key that an old snapshot holds and `CardDef` no longer has still reports as `data:<key>`.

4. **Same file: add `resourceText`** right before `function dataText`:

```ts
/** A Resource's rarity and each face's prices (R1840000, R1840001): what a sale fetches, the Credits
 * its face prints (R2521009), and what the Marketplace asks for it. */
function resourceText(resource: CardDef["resource"]): string {
  if (resource === undefined) return NONE;
  const prices = (price: typeof resource.base): string =>
    `sells for ${String(price.sellMin)}–${String(price.sellMax)} Credits, bought for ${String(price.buy)} Credits`;
  return `${resource.rarity}, ${prices(resource.base)}; Radiant ${prices(resource.radiant)}`;
}
```

   - `@jackioh/shared` does not re-export `ResourceDef`. Typing the parameter as `CardDef["resource"]` avoids touching `apps/web/src/wire/index.ts`.
   - The dash between the two prices is an en dash (`–`), as in R2521009's `Credits: 2–5`.

5. **Same file: add three lines to `fieldChanges`**, right after `value("snapshotOf", copiedText(before, names.before), copiedText(after, names.after));`:

```ts
  value("resource", resourceText(before.resource), resourceText(after.resource));
  value("ingredients", dataText(before.ingredients), dataText(after.ingredients));
  value("craft", dataText(before.craft), dataText(after.craft));
```

6. **`apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`: add the labels** after the line `"Copy of": "复制自",` (line 2186):

```json
  "Resource prices": "资源价格",
  "Ingredients": "融合材料",
  "Recipe": "配方",
```

   None of the three keys exists yet, and no source string uses them. Elsewhere in the file `"Credits"` is `信用点` and "recipe" is `配方`.

7. **`apps/web/src/patches/diff.test.ts`: update the import.** Change `import { realPatchSource, type Snapshot } from "./source.ts";` to `import { realPatchSource, type PatchChange, type Snapshot } from "./source.ts";`.

8. **Same file: add the helpers.** Put them after the `text(...)` helper (it ends at line 40) and before `async function real`:

```ts
/** patches.json names the raw fields; the diff reads a face's attack, health and X stats as its stats. */
function asDiffField(name: string): string {
  return name.replace(/^(base|radiant)\.(attack|health|xStats)$/, "$1.stats");
}

/** R388: a record and a card's diff agree: its kind, and for a changed card exactly the fields it names. */
function expectRecorded(record: PatchChange, delta: CardDelta | null, at: string): void {
  expect(delta?.kind, at).toBe(record.kind);
  if (delta?.kind === "changed") {
    expect(new Set(delta.changes.map((change) => change.field)), at).toEqual(new Set((record.fields ?? []).map(asDiffField)));
  }
}
```

9. **Same file: use the helpers in the test `"R388 every card every patch records diffs to what the record says: its kind and exactly its fields"`.**
   - Delete its comment line and its local `const asDiffField = …`, which is now at module level.
   - Replace the body of `for (const record of patch.changes) { … }` with this one line: `expectRecorded(record, diffCard(before[record.id], after[record.id]), \`${patch.version} ${record.id}\`);`
   - The assertions are the same as before.

10. **Same file: add the two new tests.** Their code and placement are in **Tests** below.

11. **Prove the type gate by hand, then undo it.**
    - Delete the line `resource: "printed",` from `CARD_KEYS` and run `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`. You should see `TS1360`/`TS2741` (`'resource' is missing`) on `CARD_KEYS` and `TS2353` on `FIELD_LABEL`. Restore the line.
    - Add a stray `artist: "data",` to `CARD_KEYS` and run typecheck again. You should see `TS2353`. Remove the line.
    - Leave no trace of either edit.

## Tests

Both new tests go in `apps/web/src/patches/diff.test.ts`.

**Test 1.** Put it in `describe("R388 a card's changes, from two snapshots")`, right after the `snapshotOf` test (`"R388 R2511001 a copy's Core card …"`, which ends at line 126):

```ts
  it("R388 a fused definition's ingredients diff under their own name, as data only", () => {
    const bolt = fixtureDef(V3, "core-002");
    const delta = diffCard(bolt, { ...bolt, ingredients: [] });
    expect(changed(delta)).toEqual([{ kind: "value", field: "ingredients", label: "Ingredients", before: "none", after: "[]" }]);
    expect(delta !== null && dataOnly(delta)).toBe(true);
  });
```

**Test 2.** Put it in `describe("R388 the real history's changes")`, right before `"R388 every card every patch records …"`:

```ts
  it("R388 R2521009 a Resource's prices diff under the name patches ship records, resource, and print on its face", async () => {
    const korrelite = defIn(await real("v0.5.0"), "stinkyscape-t-korrelite");
    const resource = korrelite.resource;
    if (resource === undefined) throw new Error("Korrelite is no Resource");
    const repriced = { ...korrelite, resource: { ...resource, base: { ...resource.base, sellMax: 6 } } };
    const delta = diffCard(korrelite, repriced);
    expect(changed(delta)).toEqual([
      {
        kind: "value",
        field: "resource",
        label: "Resource prices",
        before: "Common, sells for 2–5 Credits, bought for 5 Credits; Radiant sells for 4–10 Credits, bought for 10 Credits",
        after: "Common, sells for 2–6 Credits, bought for 5 Credits; Radiant sells for 4–10 Credits, bought for 10 Credits",
      },
    ]);
    expect(delta !== null && dataOnly(delta)).toBe(false);
    expect(delta === null ? null : faceShown(delta)).toBe("base");
    expectRecorded({ id: korrelite.id, name: korrelite.name, kind: "changed", fields: ["resource"] }, delta, korrelite.id);
  });
```

In v0.5.0, Korrelite's `resource` is: rarity `Common`, base 2/5/5, Radiant 4/10/10 (`sellMin`/`sellMax`/`buy`).

**Commands.** The wasm package must exist first: run `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`. Then:

```
pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/patches/diff.test.ts src/patches/PatchNotes.test.tsx src/patches/history.test.ts src/patches/CardHistory.test.tsx src/patches/deckChanges.test.ts src/writing.test.ts src/i18n/i18n.test.ts
pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/patches
cargo jackioh spec check
```

**What the planner already ran, as scratch copies of `diff.ts` and `diff.test.ts` (since deleted):**
- `diff.test.ts` passed 22/22: the 20 existing tests and the 2 new ones.
- Against today's `diff.ts`, both new tests failed: the diff named the fields `data:resource` and `data:ingredients`.
- eslint passed.
- Typecheck showed no error outside the missing wasm package. The wasm build finished afterwards.
- Both negative edits in step 11 failed typecheck as described.

## Done when

- [ ] Removing or adding a `CARD_KEYS` or `FIELD_LABEL` entry fails `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` (step 11 seen, then undone).
- [ ] A planted `resource` change diffs under `resource` with the label `Resource prices`, is not data only, and `expectRecorded` passes for a record naming `resource`.
- [ ] These pass: `diff.test.ts` (22 tests), `PatchNotes.test.tsx`, `history.test.ts`, `CardHistory.test.tsx`, `deckChanges.test.ts`, `writing.test.ts` and `i18n.test.ts`.
- [ ] The web typecheck and eslint are clean, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- [ ] The harness's rustfmt, catalog, patches, clippy, cargo tests and web tests pass. No Rust or catalog file changed.
- [ ] `git status` shows only the three files above changed.

## Risks

- **A shipped patch note diffs differently.** Only the keys `resource`, `ingredients` and `craft` change behavior. No record in `crates/cards/patches/patches.json` names any of them, and no snapshot holds `ingredients` or `craft`. So the real-history R388 test, `history.test.ts` and `PatchNotes.test.tsx` should stay as they are; run them to show it.
- **Hidden information (CLAUDE.md rule 7).** The diff still reads only public catalog snapshots and enforces no rule.
- **`resource`'s value text stays English** (`sells for …`), as `params` already does. Only the label is translated, through `zh-CN.json`. Do not add the value's words to `VALUE_WORDS` in `ChangeList.tsx`.
- **spec check.** Every R-id that the comments and test titles cite has a note: R179, R388, R507, R882, R1437000, R1748001, R1748002, R1840000, R1840001, R2511001 and R2521009. Cite no other. No ruling is added, so `spec/` and `spec/pending/` stay untouched.

## Open questions

Nothing blocks the build. These are the decisions made, with the alternatives rejected:

- **`resource` prints on the face; it is not data only.** A Resource's face prints its sale prices (`Credits: 2–5`, R2521009, `creditsOf` in `cards/model.ts`), `PatchFace` draws that face from the snapshot, and the Marketplace sells each lot on that face.
  - Rejected: data only. It would list a Credits change by name even though the face shows it.
  - Rejected: splitting `resource` into sub-fields so that a change to `buy` alone is data only. `changed_fields` records the whole key `resource`, and the R388 record test needs the same name.
  - Consequence: a change to only `buy`, or only the roll's rarity, also shows the card's face.
  - A person can still choose data only: change `resource: "printed"` to `"data"` and flip the Korrelite test's `dataOnly` expectation to `true`.
- **`ingredients` and `craft` get labels and data-only lines** (`Ingredients` and `Recipe`, compared as JSON as the fallback did). No catalog card carries either today.
  - Rejected: an `ignored` role, which would drop a change.
  - Rejected: leaving them to the `data:` fallback, which names them differently from `changed_fields`.
- **The `data:<key>` fallback stays** for keys an old snapshot holds that `CardDef` has lost. The existing `artist` test keeps it covered.
````

```ts
/** How the diff reads one `CardDef` key (#2607). A `printed` key and a `data` one (R507: no face prints
 * it) each have a `FIELD_LABEL` entry and a line of their own in `fieldChanges`, under the key's own
 * name, the name `patches ship` records (`changed_fields`, R388); a `face` is diffed field by field
 * (`base.text`, `radiant.stats`); an `ignored` key is never a change. */
type KeyRole = "printed" | "data" | "face" | "ignored";

/** Every `CardDef` key and its role, so a key `CardDef` gains with no entry here, or an entry for a key
 * it lost, fails the web's typecheck (#2607), as a printed or data key with no `FIELD_LABEL` does. R507:
 * fields without printed faces are listed by name. R1748001 and R1748002's flags are the Buff's data,
 * and so is the Core card a Training Grounds copy named (`snapshotOf`, in the catalogs shipped from
 * v0.5.5 to v0.5.7; R2511001). A Resource's prices print: its face prints its Credits (R2521009). */
const CARD_KEYS = {
  // The card itself: a delta's `id`, never one of its changes.
  id: "ignored",
  index: "printed",
  name: "printed",
  set: "printed",
  type: "printed",
  tags: "printed",
  rarity: "printed",
  printedRarity: "printed",
  // R1437000: display only and in no snapshot, so a change to it alone is no card change.
  flavor: "ignored",
  token: "printed",
  cost: "printed",
  refs: "data",
  params: "data",
  dealsDamage: "data",
  usesPlague: "data",
  resource: "printed",
  loc: "data",
  radiantFallback: "printed",
  // A Fuse's and a crafter's own (R179, R882), on a transient definition no snapshot holds.
  ingredients: "data",
  craft: "data",
  snapshotOf: "data",
  base: "face",
  radiant: "face",
} as const satisfies Record<keyof CardDef, KeyRole>;

type CardKey = keyof typeof CARD_KEYS;
/** The keys with a line of their own: every printed and data one. */
type LabeledKey = { [K in CardKey]: (typeof CARD_KEYS)[K] extends "printed" | "data" ? K : never }[CardKey];
/** What `fieldChanges` diffs on each face, under `<face>.<field>`. */
type FaceField = `${FaceKey}.${"type" | "stats" | "keywords" | "text" | "grants"}`;
```

```ts
/** A Resource's rarity and each face's prices (R1840000, R1840001): what a sale fetches, the Credits
 * its face prints (R2521009), and what the Marketplace asks for it. */
function resourceText(resource: CardDef["resource"]): string {
  if (resource === undefined) return NONE;
  const prices = (price: typeof resource.base): string =>
    `sells for ${String(price.sellMin)}–${String(price.sellMax)} Credits, bought for ${String(price.buy)} Credits`;
  return `${resource.rarity}, ${prices(resource.base)}; Radiant ${prices(resource.radiant)}`;
}
```

```ts
/** patches.json names the raw fields; the diff reads a face's attack, health and X stats as its stats. */
function asDiffField(name: string): string {
  return name.replace(/^(base|radiant)\.(attack|health|xStats)$/, "$1.stats");
}

/** R388: a record and a card's diff agree: its kind, and for a changed card exactly the fields it names. */
function expectRecorded(record: PatchChange, delta: CardDelta | null, at: string): void {
  expect(delta?.kind, at).toBe(record.kind);
  if (delta?.kind === "changed") {
    expect(new Set(delta.changes.map((change) => change.field)), at).toEqual(new Set((record.fields ?? []).map(asDiffField)));
  }
}
```
